usage: Usage: reply to the member's message with /{cmd} [duration] [reason], or /{cmd} @username [duration] [reason]. Durations: 30m, 2h, 1d, 1w.
need_restrict: You need Telegram's «Ban users» right for this.
mod_cant: Moderators (the «mod» list) can warn, unwarn and mute. Ask an admin for the rest.
basic_group: This works only in supergroups: Telegram can't restrict members of a basic group.
bot_cant: Aegis doesn't have the «Ban users» right here. Give it in the group's admin settings.
t_channel: Aegis can punish members only, not a channel or the group itself.
t_unknown: I don't know {name}. Reply to one of their messages, or use their numeric id.
t_self: You can't use this on yourself.
t_admin: {target} is an admin. Telegram doesn't let a bot punish admins — demote them first.
t_vip: ⭐ {target} is on the VIP list. Remove them from it first (panel → Lists).
t_mod: 🛡 {target} is a moderator too. Only admins can punish moderators.
bad_duration: That duration isn't valid: from 1 min to 366 days, e.g. 30m, 2h, 1d, 1w.
unwarned: ➖ One warning of {target} removed. Warnings now: {n}.
done_unban: ✅ {target} was unbanned and can join again (by {actor}).
